However, the note still captures pink urine and no dysuria, so core clinical context remains.

safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the explicit denial of chest pain slightly weakens documentation of negative cardiopulmonary/red-flag symptoms, which can affect triage/diagnostic framing.
